reasoning: Base ratings: the Hornets are -6.4 and the Cavaliers +2.7 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Cavaliers 18.8 better here, total 221.
Rest, travel and availability move it 1.3 towards the Hornets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
